flood-gauge-severity.text: Gauge severity is based on water level forecasts from the Google FloodHub API. Affected gauges are always visible; unaffected gauges appear as you zoom in. Forecasted trend displays the forecast for the next day relative to the current day.

flood-inundation.text: Inundation forecasts show predicted flood extent based on gauge readings. Data is sporadic and will not appear for many flood events and moments in time.

flood-gauge-severity-average.text: Average gauge severity for all affected gauges on the map over the course of the flood event.

points-of-interest.text: Airports appear at the country level; hospitals and schools appear as you zoom in.

water-infra.text: Hydropower plants and dams appear as you zoom in.

vulnerable-populations.text: Vulnerable populations by admin boundaries from WorldPop. Data appears as you zoom into the country of interest.

movement.text: Average movement per day to and from an area. Data appears where available as you zoom in.

heat-risk-level.text: This is a proof of concept layer based on an API by the Harvard team.
